description: Query time-series monitoring data from Cloud Insight. Returns metric data for a specific product and metric. The aggregation must match one configured in the product schema.

cw_key.description: Product key (cw_key) identifying the service (see Cloud Insight metrics)

dimensions.description: Dimensions identifying the resource as key-value pairs (required, e.g., {"instanceNo": "12345"})

queryAggregation.description: How to aggregate query results when the query interval is coarser than stored data (default: AVG)

timeEnd.description: End time in Unix epoch milliseconds

timeStart.description: Start time in Unix epoch milliseconds

name: ncloud_query_monitoring_data
